title: library_set_linkage: add schema validation (require linkageId when exporting)
description: In packages/agent-protocol/src/index.ts (~line 518-530), the LibrarySetLinkageParamsSchema has all fields after symbolId as optional with no constraints. This allows calling library_set_linkage with only symbolId (all other fields absent), which is a silent no-op. Fix: add a .refine() or .superRefine() constraint that ensures at least one of linkageId, exportForActionScript, exportInFirstFrame is provided. Also optionally validate that if exportForActionScript=true, a linkageId must be present (standard Flash 8 behavior). Keep the existing export: all types should still be exported after the change.
